feature: SharedChannel server duplex combined-slice large response

candidate.design: ServerDuplex.writeMessage uses compression.compressAlloc and a stack five-byte prefix, then writes both slices through ServerDuplexStream.writeResponseSlicesBurst so the prefix and payload share one DATA frame sequence. Small messages keep the framed fallback.

scope.workload: SharedChannel persistent duplex, 262144-byte request and response

benchmark_method.schedule: five ABBA rounds; baseline, candidate, candidate, baseline
benchmark_method.host: shared host with unrelated load; no CPU pinning
benchmark_method.metric: ns_per_roundtrip from the benchmark result record

correctness.large_duplex_test: a 100,000-byte server duplex response passed and a counting allocator observed zero allocations at or above the payload size

context: The earlier writeResponseParts variant emitted a separate five-byte DATA frame and regressed 2.9%. The combined slice burst removes that extra frame, turning the same allocation removal into a small paired win.
